Mohini Devi
--Petitioner
 Versus
Poonam Agarwal
--Respondent
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Jai Krishna Pandey, learned counsel 
for the petitioner.
2. Issue notice to respondent nos. 1 to 3 
returnable at an early date.
3. Apart from normal mode, petitioner is 
permitted to serve respondent nos. 1 to 3 by 
all permissible modes, including 
electronically. 
4. Steps to be taken within 24 hours. 
5. List this case on 27.07.2026.
6. In the meantime, petitioner shall be at 
liberty to move adjournment application 
seeking adjournment before the court of 
learned Civil Judge (S.D.), Haldwani, and if 
such application is made, learned court 
concerned shall consider the same for 
adjournment, only till 27.07.2026.
7. Stay application (IA No. 1 of 2026) 
stands disposed of. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 06.07.2026
Aswal

Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Jai Krishna Pandey, learned counsel 
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pande, Advocate has put in 
appearance on behalf of respondent nos. 1 
to 3.
3. Learned counsels for the parties are 
sanguine that since it is a family dispute, 
therefore, it can be resolved through 
counselling. 
4. In such view of the matter, let both the 
parties appear before the Mediation Centre 
attached to this Court, on 03.08.2026. 
Mediator’s report shall be placed on record 
within one week thereafter.
5. List this case on 12.08.2026.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
